title: Cyclone — hands-first review of AI actions
description:
Cyclone puts held AI actions on a miniature factory at your desk. Inspect a proposal, scrub its kinematic rehearsal, amend the value, and decide with your hands. Every demo decision retains a signed local receipt and the model evidence that was reviewed.

This is actual Immersive Web Emulator footage, edited from two hand-driven takes at normal speed. The end card is the application's capture scene. Inputs are emulated; signatures use a local demo key; execution is simulated. No real machine is connected. A rehearsal is not a prediction or guarantee, and a signed record is not proof of physical execution.

Try the demo: https://ocularminds.github.io/cyclone/

Built with IWSDK 1.0.1, TypeScript and WebXR. Physical Quest performance, native room anchoring and provisioned live-service acceptance remain separate checks. Submission target: Productivity / New Experience.
